code_summary: One independently trained SASRec per category, with tied item embeddings and learned item biases. A causal mean of the five most recent nonpadding item embeddings passes through a projection and sigmoid gate, then joins the transformer representation through a normalized residual. Training uses 2,048 shared uniform negatives and a 2,048-token cap. Checkpoints are selected by validation HR@10 with NDCG tie-breaking, and the exported predictor strictly loads one selected checkpoint per category. Added checks cover recent means, causality, padding zeros, finite gradients, and serialization/export score agreement; their completion is unconfirmed because the trial crashed.
